find: const bases = await resolveBaseCommits(run_host, repo_path, base_branch)
rationale: Round 10's load-bearing change, re-pointed off round 9's target as the contract requires. The reader already refused to trust a local base ref for ARTIFACT membership, but the GATE still bound claim.file through the bare base NAME — so a local base sitting behind its remote put a predecessor's merged files inside the range, and a nomination pointing at one of them satisfied 'the proof must break a line THIS branch changed'. Resolving the base to every commit it names, binding the nomination to the INTERSECTION of those ranges while the prose exemption keeps the UNION, is what closes that. Emptying the resolution restores the bare name and reopens exactly that hole: the scripted stale-base cases and the real-git clone case go red, while the contract-text suite, which never reads a branch diff, stays green.
